name: Exact Change
summary: A cash on delivery checkout where you stack the PKR notes you will hand over and see your change
about: A cash on delivery step for a PKR 3,770 order. Tap notes from 10 to 5,000 and each one flies onto a green felt tray, spinning into a loose pile, while the amount you hand over rolls up and the change the rider must bring is split into notes and coins. Exact amount counts in the fewest notes, and confirming squares the pile, snaps a rubber band round it and seals it in a stamped envelope.
how: Tap a note button: the note arcs onto the felt tray and the pile settles with a small bump
Watch You hand over roll up; the change box says how much is still missing or what the rider brings back
Exact amount clears the tray and counts in the fewest notes; Take back and Clear lift notes away
Check the mobile number the rider calls (it must look like 0301 2345678)
Confirm squares the pile, snaps a band round it and seals it in an envelope with a stamp and confetti
